title: Vehicle Service Contracts: Claims, Limits and Refunds by Contract and Vehicle
content:
Desk guidance for Vehicle Service Contracts on what each service contract's claims, limits, deductibles and refunds belong to, how it stands beside a GAP waiver addendum on the same retail installment contract, and what a payoff does to it.

## 1. One contract, one vehicle

Claims, limits, deductibles and refunds belong to one service contract and one vehicle; claims on another vehicle of the same borrower never count against this contract's lifetime claim limit.

*Hypothetical case.* A borrower holds a Vehicle Service Contract on a sedan and another on a pickup. Claims authorized under the pickup's contract do not reduce what remains of the sedan contract's lifetime claim limit, and the sedan contract's deductibles and refund are reckoned on the sedan contract alone.

## 2. Beside a GAP waiver addendum

A service contract and a GAP waiver addendum (GAP Waiver Addenda) on the same retail installment contract are cancelled and refunded independently; when the vehicle is a total loss, the service contract's refund (computed as of the date of loss) is also what the GAP benefit excludes, so the refund is computed even when it is credited after the GAP decision.

| Situation on one retail installment contract | Service contract | GAP waiver addendum |
|---|---|---|
| Cancellation and refund | Cancelled and refunded on its own | Cancelled and refunded on its own |
| Vehicle a total loss | Its refund is computed as of the date of loss, and that refund is also what the GAP benefit excludes | — |
| Timing of the refund credit after a total loss | The refund is computed even when it is credited after the GAP decision | — |

## 3. Payoff of the retail installment contract

Paying the retail installment contract off leaves the service contract in force with the vehicle, unlike the GAP waiver.

*Hypothetical case.* A borrower pays a Retail Installment Contract off while its Vehicle Service Contract still has time and mileage remaining: the service contract stays in force with the vehicle.
